verdict.rationale: Vercel's Marketplace ships first-party integrations (Neon Postgres, Pinecone, Shopify, Better Stack, Slack, Statsig, etc.) categorized under Database/Analytics/Commerce/AI, plus environment-variable management across environments, which together function as native bindings reducing manual SDK/credential wiring. However, a hands-on community report states that securely connecting Vercel to a database beyond a plain password requires contacting sales for an Enterprise plan, contradicting the 'minimal boilerplate' framing for security-conscious setups. Missing for 10: first-party docs detailing how bindings auto-inject credentials/config with zero manual wiring, independent corroboration of ease-of-use, and resolution of the enterprise-gating friction for secure DB connections.
